page.layout: One column of Hebrew-Latin lexicon entries, with a Hebrew running head at the top right and the page number at the top right. No marginal notes. A catchword stands at the lower right below the last line.

main_text.p: pter multiplicari vel multiplicare vos, Ezech. 5.7.
הן En, Ecce: An; Num? Vide & היא. Chald.
הן Si: די הן איתי: הן Quod si: להן זהן לא [?] Sive futurum est, להן [?] Sive non. Chald. vide suo loco.
הנה Huc: הנה והנה Huc & illuc. עד הנה, & contracte עדנה Huc usq;
הפה Pihel, Siluit, Tacuit. Ex Hiphil ויהם Et silere fecit, Compescuit, Num.13.31.
הפך Vertit, Mutavit: Versus, vel Mutatus fuit. Niphal נהפך Versus, Mutatus fuit, Vertit se. Hophal הוהפך idem: Hithpahel התהפך Idem.
הרג Occidit, Interfecit. Niphal נהרג Occisus fuit. Pyhal הרג idem.
הרג m. הרגה f. Occisio, Interfectio.

page.notes: Hebrew and Greek-type forms in the lower entries are partly blurred by stains; the vocalised Hebrew forms in the Chaldee entries (הן, להן, הנה, עד הנה) and the forms after "Niphal" and "Hophal" are doubtful and may contain errors. Marked [?] where I could not read a letter with confidence. The running head is in Hebrew letters at the top right. The page is discoloured with stains throughout.
